en: The postcard depicts an old European train station building with classic 19th-century architectural features—arched windows, stonework, and a green copper roof. In the foreground, there's an old-style tram or streetcar and a person standing in a nearly empty, cobblestone square. The sky is pastel and the scene is hand-tinted. In the upper left corner, the text reads 'Libau - Bahnhof.'
